subject: Priority trim & dependency commitments ahead of July QBR
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@horizonretail.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priority trim & dependency commitments ahead of July QBR

Team —

Quick mid-quarter pulse and an ask ahead of the July QBR (deck attached). High-level goals: tighten scope for the customer-facing metrics we'll present, crystallize owners for blocking dependencies, and lock any timeline concessions before the QBR readout.

Key asks (please reply inline with owner + ETA):
- Trim backlog: which sub-features under "LLM caching" can we defer to next quarter? (owner + commit date)
- Performance threshold: can the infra team commit to the reduced 95th-p50 latency target for the demo (we can accept a relaxed SLO for demonstration only)?
- Procurement/contract: Horizon said they'll need a PO by end of month — need CS + Sales to confirm procurement contact and SOW edits.

Attached: QBR_prep_deck_v1.pdf (draft), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MVP asks).

Timeline: please add explicit commitments by Tue 2026-07-14 EOD so we can lock the deck.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: QBR_prep_deck_v1.pdf (2.1MB)]
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (34KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority trim & dependency commitments ahead of July QBR

Neha —

Thanks for the concise ask. Quick responses inline:

- Trim backlog: from the LLM caching work, we can defer the async-prefetching piece (low customer impact) to next quarter. Owner: Marcus. ETA: Aug 20 for reschedule.

- Performance threshold: we can present a demo-level SLO: reduce the target to 25% slower at 95p for demo only. If Product will call this out clearly it avoids a signal issue. Owner: Infra (me) + Product (Marcus) to sign off by Mon 7/13.

- Procurement/contract: we need an updated SOW with the PO line items called out. CS should loop procurement@horizonretail.com and copy Legal for redlines.

One ask from Eng: if we trim the demo scope, can Product prioritize the end-to-end happy path (no custom routing) so infra doesn't have to over-provision? This reduces the capacity ask.

I'll put a short note into the infra runbook for demo scaling knobs.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering
[Sent from mobile]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority trim & dependency commitments ahead of July QBR

On Sat, Jul 11, 2026 at 10:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Neha —
>
> Thanks for the concise ask. Quick responses inline:
>
> - Trim backlog: from the LLM caching work, we can defer the async-prefetching piece (low customer impact) to next quarter. Owner: Marcus. ETA: Aug 20 for reschedule.

Agree with the deferral — I'll re-scope the OKR for Q3 to reflect a smaller delivery that preserves the caching baseline for production. Proposed change (high level):

- OKR: Improve inference economics for interactive workloads (Q3 scope: prefix/KV cache baseline + telemetry; defer async-prefetching and multi-tenant cache compaction).
- Success metrics (trimmed): 10% unit-cost improvement (instead of 18%), retain current 95p latency SLO for production but mark demo-level SLO as "relaxed" in the QBR notes.

Dependency owners and quick commits:
- Marcus -> implement staged rollout plan and update MAP by Mon 7/13. [Attachment: capacity_plan.csv (4KB)]
- Vivek -> confirm infra demo knobs by Mon 7/13 and list required capacity (CPU/GPU hours).
- Neha -> confirm Horizon procurement contact + expected PO date.

I'll upload an updated one-page OKR blurb to the shared drive by EOD Mon. If anyone expects major downstream impact from the re-scope, flag here.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: capacity_plan.csv (4KB)]
